Definition
[Bounded linear operator] ↗ def:linear-operator-banach 1. appD:D.3-def-2\group Functional Analysis

A linear operator $A:X\to Y$ is bounded if \[ \| A\| :=\sup \{ \| Au\| _Y\mid \| u\| _X\leq 1\} <\infty . \]

Every bounded linear operator $A:X\to Y$ is continuous.
